text:
toni: weird streaming toolcall issue in node SDK. when using json-mode + chunked upload, numeric fields end up quoted after a retry/concat.

marc: can you paste a tiny repro?

toni: simple: callTool('ingest', {batchSize: 100}) over streaming transport. first chunk errs, retry replays concatenated chunks as a string, server sees {batchSize: "100"}.

ivy: ah that matches a bug i glanced at: chunk buffer was being joined and then reused without re-parsing. if chunk parts were numbers they become stringified.

toni: CI caught it: samples/streaming-ingest e2e failed, test toolcall-stream-number.test.js

ci-bot: failure: samples/streaming-ingest e2e  test failing (toolcall-stream-number.test.js)

marc: assigned to @sdk-team. likely fix: store raw chunks as buffers/objects for retry, don't join into a single string until send-time and always re-run serializer.

toni: local quickfix: on retry do JSON.parse(bufferString) -> JSON.stringify(obj) before send; but that's hacky and expensive. better to keep original structure.

ivy: add tests for (streaming vs non-streaming) x (number|string unions) x (retry via auth/network). also add a sample regression test.

marc: PR incoming. changelog draft: "fix(node-sdk): preserve numeric types in streaming toolcall retries (json-mode)"

toni: note: also affects optional numeric fields when absent -> some codepaths reconstruct metadata with default 0; include absent-vs-default matrix.

sdk-team: ack. will include SSE and fetch/http transport checks in CI matrix.

toni: thanks, marking this thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
